Tie the comparison to the delayed-delivery commitment from the spine.

QwenGyre (Alibaba, arXiv:2609.33848, Oct 2026): an elastic RL framework for training XLong-horizon agents. Use it to (a) ground the extreme-long-horizon scale in Segment 8 (hours, hundreds of model-environment interactions, ~1M tokens per rollout) and (b) ground compaction-in-practice: production harnesses compact saturated histories into summary branches, delegate sub-tasks to sub-agents with isolated contexts, and retry failed paths. Scope caution: it is an RL-training-infrastructure paper (cites=0, not canonical); cite it for the real-harness practice it describes, not as evidence about compaction quality.
